title: company-brain org config
description: Describes an operator's departments and the folders they own. bin/init.mjs turns this into briefs, ledgers, links and an atlas.

name.description: Shown in the atlas header and the generated HOME.md.

tagline.description: One short line under the atlas title.

atlasTitle.description: Browser tab title for the atlas. Defaults to "<name> Org Atlas".

roots.description: key -> absolute path. Each becomes vaults/<key> as a junction (Windows) or symlink (macOS, Linux). Supports ~ and forward slashes everywhere.

loose.description: key -> absolute path, for one-off folders outside the roots. Each becomes vaults/loose/<key>.

id.description: Lowercase, filename-safe. Becomes departments/<id>.md and state/<id>.md.

sub.description: Two or three words under the name in the atlas.

color.description: Hex. Give each department a distinguishable hue.

mission.description: One sentence. What this department is for.

home.description: The single path most work in this department touches.

note.description: The two or three facts a session keeps needing. Shown in the atlas and read at the start of every brief.

paths.description: Every folder this department owns, relative to the org root. Scanned by sync-inventory to detect drift.

clusters.description: Named groups of units. Drives the atlas constellation and the brief's inventory table.

label.description: Keep under about 18 characters so it fits on the map.

type.description: core = something you use, tool = an external connector, gap = does not exist yet. Gaps are drawn in gold and drive /review.

desc.description: One or two sentences. Shown when the orb is opened.

where.description: Real path, or where it would live if it is a gap.

mcpServers.description: Copied verbatim into a generated .mcp.json at the org root. Same shape Claude Code expects.
